title: Kiss: Psycho Circus - The Nightmare Child/Armor Pieces
text:
During the game you will find armor pieces which will make your character stronger and provide him with special abilities. All armor pieces you receive are always obtained in this order:

Elder Gauntlets
 Increases health to 100.
 Increases ammo limit to 200 and allows you to pick up ammo.
 Provides with a basic melee weapon.

Elder Boots
 Increases ammo limit to 300.
 Allows you to jump higher.

Elder Belt
 Increases ammo limit to 400.
 Allows you to move faster.

Elder Vest
 Increases ammo limit to 500.
 Doubles damage dealt with melee weapons and Scourge.

Elder Plate
 Increases health to 200.
 Increases ammo limit to 600.

Elder Mask
 Increases health to 250.
 Increases ammo limit to 700.
 Hawk Eyes becomes a permanent ability.
